scope: Adds an isolated supabase_oidc_poc authentication mode for a temporary Streamlit Community Cloud deployment
Uses Streamlit native OIDC identity cookies while keeping Supabase as the identity source
Maps the Supabase OIDC subject and email to existing HealthyMe Admin and Member roles
Adds a same-app OAuth consent page for Supabase OAuth Server authorization
Documents exact secrets, controlled dashboard steps, acceptance tests and rollback
known_limitations: OpenID Connect requires asymmetric Supabase JWT signing keys
The PoC requires a temporary Streamlit app and a controlled Supabase Site URL test window
The production H13R1 password login remains the active production route
excluded: No Flutter or Admin Lite change
No assessment, report, recommendation, schedule or member-data contract change
No credentials or real secrets committed to GitHub
